name: convfusion
description: Research operating system for Claude Code: 53 research-methodology skills (topic understanding through systematic literature synthesis, experiment design, analysis, academic writing, peer review and journal-audit simulation, patents/reports/slides), a /research entry point, a UserPromptSubmit hook that auto-injects per-turn research status (harness-style, no model call), and plain-file conventions for tracking evidence, claims, decisions, plans and papers in your workspace. No API key, no server — runs entirely on Claude Code's own Read/Write/Bash/WebFetch tools plus one local Python script.
